title: Locate the letter b in the word failbench
rationale: Off-by-one indexing errors silently corrupt string slicing and offset calculations, so a model's positional arithmetic must stay stable across repeated calls.

prompt.content: You are a precise assistant. Answer with the number only, with no other text.
In the word failbench, what is the position of the letter b when counting from the left with the first letter at position 1? Answer with the number only.

notes: Repeats=3 and all three must pass. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, one integer answer. Expected value 5: failbench is f-a-i-l-b-e-n-c-h, so b is the fifth character when counted from 1. Brittleness: a 0-based answer of 4 fails, which is the intended off-by-one failure mode.
